description: Benchmark baseline captured after Tranches O–T (post-N): bbnf-regex inline tests extracted to tests/, bbnf-regex benches/ added (4 binaries), 21 god modules >500 LOC split into directory modules across bbnf-ir / bbnf core / bbnf analysis / bbnf-ser / parse_that / bbnf-regex. Public APIs preserved via re-exports; zero behavior change. Tranches J/K/L/M/N (the post-H/I gates: scheduler correctness, CSP-scheduled rewrite execution, NodeId everywhere, dead-lattice purge, deterministic codegen) shipped earlier and are folded into this baseline.
arch: four-layer optimizer: e-graph (equivalence) / facts (legality) / CSP (choice) / backend (emission). Grammar tier and bbnf-regex HIR tier are isomorphic — parallel ENode types (GrammarENode, HirENode), same Rewrite trait substrate, same CspScheduler, mirrored rule files, shared CostWeights in egraph::cost_weights. CspScheduler is the production default in both tiers; BackoffScheduler is the reference implementation.

bbnf_regex.note: extracted from inline tests in Tranche O

soft.actual_parse_time_delta: All bbnf core bench rows are 3.7–7.0% faster than post-H (well inside the ±2% gate, in the favorable direction). The acceleration is attributable to deterministic codegen (Tranche N) eliminating SCC ordering noise plus the CSP scheduler reducing redundant rewrite searches in saturated tiers.
soft.compile_pipeline_shape_change: post-H reported a single compile_pipeline ns_per_iter; the post-N harness exposes 6 per-grammar measurements (compile_bbnf / compile_css_l4 / compile_css_mono / compile_ebnf / compile_json / compile_sheets), each with finer-grained per-grammar attribution.

structure_changes.tranche_o: 9 inline #[cfg(test)] modules in bbnf-regex/src/ extracted to bbnf-regex/tests/. Visibility widening: merge_bounds + 4 Match types (DedupMatch, AbsorbRepetitionMatch, AbsorbMatch, UnionMatch) re-exported from egraph::rules.
structure_changes.tranche_p: bbnf-regex/benches/ created with 4 bench binaries: regex_parse, regex_classify, regex_hir_egraph, regex_dfa_compile. Cargo.toml gained [dev-dependencies] (bencher + mimalloc).
structure_changes.tranche_q: 6 bbnf-ir god modules split into directory modules: lib.rs → types/, passes/sets/dispatch.rs → dispatch/, vm/interpreter.rs → vm/interpreter/, vm/compiler.rs → vm/compiler/, passes/types/constraint.rs → constraint/, passes/transform/fuse_token.rs → fuse_token/.
structure_changes.tranche_r: 5 bbnf core god modules split: backend/rust/emitter/mod.rs gained leaves/seq/binary/operator_chain/map_value/grammar siblings. backend/rust/emitter/prettify.rs → prettify/. backend/ts/emitter.rs → ts/emitter/. backend/wasm/emitter.rs → wasm/emitter/. imports.rs → imports/.
structure_changes.tranche_s: 4 bbnf analysis + ser splits: state/diagnostics.rs → state/diagnostics/, state/ast_utils.rs → state/ast_utils/, features/hover.rs → features/hover/, ser/lib.rs split into traits/writer/string/slice siblings.
structure_changes.tranche_t: 6 parse-that splits: parse_that/combinators/methods.rs → methods/, parse_that/parsers/eisel_lemire.rs → eisel_lemire/ (table.rs is 660-LOC pure data, exempt). parse_that/parsers/scan.rs → scan/. parse_that/span_parser/mod.rs gained 6 sibling files. bbnf-regex/hir/parser.rs → parser/. bbnf-regex/info.rs → info/.
